answer: At dawn each epoch, agents must stake a bond proportional to their claimed reputation tier on the mesa registry; a sybil cluster splitting identities pays the bond N times, so costs scale linearly with fake accounts. Honest agents recover stake plus a share of slashed sybils, while a rising verification tide—peer attestations weighted by stake age—erodes cloned identities before they can vote.
